Feature works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: market_conditions.py inline model classes and helpers are in a router file that reuses globals (api_router, db, get_current_user, is_owner, tenant_id, utcnow) — these must be imported/injected by the main server module; verified indirectly since all endpoints return correct data.
Compare endpoint fallback: when index_id omitted, defaults to first index of commodity — verified via GET /market/official/compare?commodity=luce&period=2026-06 returning index.id='gme_pun'.
Idempotent upsert relies on deterministic record_id 'mk_off_{tid[:8]}_{commodity}_{index_id}_{period}' — verified same record_id on re-post.
seed_data_creation: Test seeded a few official records (2026-04, 2026-05, 2026-03 for gme_pun luce; 2026-02 gas gme_psv deleted at end). Notes prefixed with TEST_ for cleanup identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend login flow requires ~7s wait after page.goto for the AnimatedSplash overlay to disappear before auth-email-input becomes visible/clickable. Use state='visible' in wait_for_selector. Owner test@dalpastro.it and sub1@dalpastro.it credentials work. After login, URL redirects to /home. Seeded competitor records for luce (Enel Energia 0.152, Edison 0.139 €/kWh) already present in tenant. /market/official records survive between tests; use unique periods to avoid conflicts.
